planets.name: HAT-P-23 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Moriah with a 1.21-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-23 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Moriah. Its orbit and size follow Bakos et al. 2010's fit, the archive's default.
